headline: Bountiful Season for Sunflowers! Harvest Is Abundant, Tax Is Down, Now It's Time for Labeling
summary: Turkey's sunflower production is expected to rise 17% to about 2.3 million tons after 1.94 million tons last year. The customs duty on sunflower seed imports was cut from 20% to 12% from October 1.
why: Sunflower seed is a key input for Turkey's edible oil industry, and import duties affect domestic oilseed prices and crushing margins.
